notes.title: New features! Thanks to you!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We took in consideration some of your suggestions, so we updated Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations to have a few new features! Doing puzzles never been so easy!

Here is the list!

[list]
[*]Added a title to see where you are in all moments, including DLC names
[*]You can order DLCs by date or name
[*]If you started a puzzle, it will show a "In progress" band and if you hover it with the cursor it will show how many pieces are in place
[*]New small size for the preview image, just press right mouse button!
[*]Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

Thanks for your suggestions! If you like our game, please support us!

[h1]Keep relaxing and do puzzles![/h1]

notes.title: New features thanks to your suggestions!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We listen to you! And we are happy to announce a few changes to make everyone's experiences more comfy and relaxing! Here is the list of improvements:

[list]
[*] Added a button in the menu to empty the bottom box completely
[*] Added a button to show only the puzzle edges (or you can do it by pressing B)
[*] Added an option to drag pieces without keeping the mouse button pressed (one click grabs, one click drops)
[*] Added a button to clean all the pieces in the board
[*] Now the shuffle button only shuffles the pieces outside the board
[*] Now you can move a piece out of the box with the mouse middle button or Ctrl
[/list]

That's it! Please enjoy it and if you have more suggestions let us know in the discussion forums!

[h1]Stay safe, keep relaxing and do puzzles![/h1]
